describes: packages/plugin/selection: text selection over engine geometry, the pointer handler, copy, permissions.

cases.name: requires-interaction
cases.covers: Selection requires the interaction hub; without it the kernel refuses the plugin list with the token hint.

$error.name: Error
$error.message: Plugin "selection" requires capability "interaction", which no plugin provides — add interactionPlugin() from '@embedpdf/plugin-interaction' to your plugins list.

cases.name: capability-and-initial-state
cases.covers: The capability object in literal member order (the public and host lenses are one object), the initial slice, and the handler registered with the hub at init.

cases.name: permission-twins
cases.covers: canSelect is doc.text.select and canCopy doc.text.copy; neither implies the other.
cases.reason: Pins the permission twins and text reads (batching, ranges, cancellation), through call outcomes and engine reads. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: hover-warms-and-claims-the-ibeam
cases.covers: The first hover over a page warms its geometry (one read, deduplicated while in flight); once loaded, hover over text claims the I-beam at priority 10, off-text and over a gap release it.

cases.name: ensure-page-guards
cases.covers: ensurePage issues nothing for a loaded or in-flight page, a page not in the registry, or without doc.text.select; a failed read clears in-flight so a later call retries; a second PAGE_LOADED for the same page is not a change.

cases.name: click-then-drag
cases.covers: A single-click down on text clears and captures but selects nothing; moves under the 4px threshold stay a click; past it the gesture opens at the anchor (selecting, change) and extends to the pointer; the up settles and commits. The snapshot, pages, segments, rects, menu anchor and text follow.

cases.name: down-off-text-and-over-gaps
cases.covers: A down on blank page space clears the selection and declines, so a lower handler gets the gesture; a down over a gap declines without clearing; a move without an anchor does nothing.

cases.name: word-and-line-clicks
cases.covers: A double-click selects the word (capturing even off-text), a triple-click the visual line; a touch long-press that engages a word ticks the feedback provider, one on blank space or a mouse double-click does not.

cases.name: word-click-before-geometry
cases.covers: A double-click on a page whose geometry has not loaded selects nothing and no feedback fires.

cases.name: cancel-drops-the-drag
cases.covers: A cancelled drag clears the in-flight selection and settles the gesture (commit fires with nothing selected).

cases.name: cross-page-drag
cases.covers: A drag onto a page that has not loaded warms it and keeps the last focus; when its geometry arrives the selection recomputes across the pages. A backward drag orders the ends by document position.

cases.name: programmatic-select
cases.covers: select() takes a cross-page range or a single-page span, clamps a negative start, clears on an empty range, maps an end at index 0 to the previous page, refuses unknown pages, and is born settled. selectAll selects every character and settles its open end as geometry arrives.

cases.name: select-refused
cases.covers: Without doc.text.select, select and selectAll throw PermissionDenied and the gesture functions are inert: no warming, no hit tests, the handler declines. clear is always allowed.

cases.name: select-all-empty-document
cases.covers: selectAll on a document with no pages does nothing.

cases.name: read-text
cases.covers: readText resolves "" with nothing selected, rejects PermissionDenied without doc.text.copy, joins pages with a newline, slices through the char map, reads each page once (shared while in flight), and evicts a failed read so the next call retries.
cases.reason: Pins the permission twins and text reads (batching, ranges, cancellation), through call outcomes and engine reads. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: endpoints
cases.covers: A snapshot endpoint sits on its boundary glyph cell, or on the segment when that glyph is degenerate (a generated line break); an endpoint on a page with no segments yet is null, and the menu anchor falls back to the last page with segments.

cases.name: endpoints-follow-their-segment
cases.covers: The start endpoint takes the first segment's reading direction and the end the last's: a selection from a left-to-right line into a right-to-left one.

cases.name: backward-drag-on-one-page
cases.covers: A drag that ends before its anchor on the same page orders the ends backward.

cases.name: drag-threshold
cases.covers: The drag threshold is 4 viewport px, measured from the down: 3.9 is still a click, exactly 4 begins the drag.

cases.name: handler-priority
cases.covers: The text handler sits at priority 60: a capturing handler at 59 only gets the downs it declines. Each gesture names its handler, the text handler as 'text-select'.

cases.name: registry-changes
cases.covers: A page mutation (revision bump) recomputes the selection from cached geometry with no refetch (a rotation re-derives the transform), drops the caches of pages that left, and clears when an endpoint page is gone; events that change no structure are ignored.

cases.name: a-crop-change-re-derives-the-seam
cases.covers: The seam is keyed by the rotation, userUnit and crop box: a registry change that moves a page crop box re-derives it from the cached layout, so the recomputed segments land in the new content space.

cases.name: content-invalidation
cases.covers: redaction.applied and pages.flattened drop every cache and clear the selection; a geometry read in flight from before is discarded when it lands, and the next warm refetches.

cases.name: late-geometry-without-selection
cases.covers: A page that loads while nothing is selected only marks itself loaded; a failed read is ignored.

cases.name: gesture-verbs
cases.covers: The host verbs directly: beginAt opens a caret selection, extendTo moves the focus (keeping it off-text, ignoring a no-selection call), end settles and commits; highlight visibility round-trips; change and commit unsubscribes answer whether they were subscribed.

cases.name: pan-disables-selection
cases.covers: Under the pan tool the text handler is not eligible: no warming, no capture.

cases.name: close-releases-subscriptions
cases.covers: Closing the document releases the store and event subscriptions.
cases.reason: Pins the permission twins and text reads (batching, ranges, cancellation), through call outcomes and engine reads. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: select-page
cases.covers: selectPage selects every character of one page: a loaded page at once, an unloaded one as an open range that warms the page and settles when its geometry lands (a system change); a page outside the document throws not-found.

cases.name: refused-writes-and-copy-only
cases.covers: Without doc.text.select every selection write throws permission-denied (selectPage, selectWordAt, selectLineAt, extendTo), beginGestureAt answers false, and warming resolves without a read; readTextInRange still works with doc.text.copy alone.

cases.name: read-text-in-range
cases.covers: readTextInRange reads any range without touching the selection: an empty or backward range is "" without reading the page, an end at index 0 stops at the previous page, a negative start clamps, a range spans pages; a page outside the document rejects not-found and a caller without doc.text.copy permission-denied. Options without a signal read normally.
cases.reason: Pins the permission twins and text reads (batching, ranges, cancellation), through call outcomes and engine reads. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: read-text-cancelled
cases.covers: readText checks its signal before each batch of page reads and once more after the last: an already aborted signal rejects operation-cancelled with no read, an abort while the first batch is in flight rejects before the second batch is issued, an abort during a single batch rejects when it lands, and a signal that never aborts reads normally.
cases.reason: Pins the permission twins and text reads (batching, ranges, cancellation), through call outcomes and engine reads. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: drag-threshold-config
cases.covers: selectionPlugin({ dragThreshold }) sets the viewport distance a press travels before it becomes a drag: 9.9 px is still a click at 10, exactly 10 begins the drag.

cases.name: events-and-origins
cases.covers: onChanged carries the range, the pages with segments and the origin; onCleared fires only when a selection is actually dropped; writes are the api's outside a gesture and the user's inside one (beginGesture opens it with no selection); endGesture with nothing selected commits nothing; a content change clears with a system origin. getRange and listRects read the model.
